about: Prasugrel Lupin (prasugrel), by brand name only, is supplied eleven times from December 2025 to September 2026 to a 76-year-old man.
Persantin SR (dipyridamole) is supplied four times from January to April 2026 to a 74-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.
The only antiplatelet medicine is Plavix (clopidogrel), which is not on the list and which the source suggests as an alternative, so the criterion is not met.
